title: How the AI Economy Became Completely Circular #economy #AI
description:
Is the AI bubble built on actual profit or just circular tech spending?

We examine how major players like OpenAI and Amazon are fueling current growth through massive chip investments and IOU-based funding models. This analysis breaks down whether projected revenue can sustain the current infrastructure gold rush.

Subscribe for more breakdowns on market trends and comment your thoughts on the future of AI.

top_comments.author: @Smoked_salmon_and_cream_cheese
top_comments.text: This is really interesting and not something I was aware of! AI is great as a tool but I’m a BA in a level company and it seems that our senior leadership think we can be replaced and roles consolidated because AI can do it all for anyone who asks. I appreciate it can augment most roles in tech quite successfully but I’m worried about the direction of travel beyond that, where it’s being looked at as a replacement. Would love to see a video on what you think will happen in the future re human skill replacement.

top_comments.author: @realsteverioux
top_comments.text: The circular spending pattern is a legitimate warning sign, but it’s not sufficient evidence on its own that AI is a bubble. The decisive factor is whether end-user value eventually catches up with the investment.
